title: IntradayLab: independent fixed T3 M15 Forever baseline v1
body:
T3/M15 historical reproduction now runs independently inside `IntradayLab/t3_m15_forever_v1/`, using exactly two fixed controls and pinned forever data. It reproduces every Si/CNY reference trade and extends the same logic to GLDRUBF/IMOEXF without executable TradingSystemLab imports or new optimization.

**Draft only. Stop here for external audit and user decision; no merge or auto-merge.**

- Actual discovery/main and base: `7927d3d6b465ec1bceae51ec8121def5e7c7e191` (unchanged before/after).
- Actual data/main and mandatory data pin: `f8486b446cf3d5f9f3cba6dfec32bdef8fd184c8` (unchanged, clean, read-only).
- Research commit: `76820f0a3658b13bd1aa306e97d04695d8b7ba5f`; separate branch `research/t3-m15-forever-v1`.
- Gate A **PASS**: all 425 Baseline and 401 Optimized records reproduced, zero differences outside strict documented absolute tolerances; all 59,523 Si/CNY timestamps/OHLCV exactly match quarterly sources. Historical controls: Baseline 196/229 trades, PF 2.179/1.107, +88.98/+11.76R; Optimized 185/216, PF 2.177/1.255, +93.36/+28.13R.
- Gate B **PASS for fixed normalized C1 research model**: GLD unit 0.1 RUB, IMOEX unit 0.5 points anchored in dated official MOEX launch announcements; every historical OHLC passes Decimal grid, R monetary multiplier cancels. Original Si/CNY unit 0.001 retained. Full archived DOC could not be read; exhaustive dated contract terms are not asserted.

| Version | Instrument | 2023: trades / PF / Net R | 2024: trades / PF / Net R | Positive available calendar months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BASELINE | USDRUBF | 111 / 2.658 / +64.02 | 115 / 1.054 / +2.97 | 16/24 (66.7%) |
| BASELINE | CNYRUBF | 85 / 1.677 / +24.96 | 114 / 1.159 / +8.80 | 14/24 (58.3%) |

| OPTIMIZED | USDRUBF | 103 / 2.701 / +69.87 | 110 / 1.077 / +4.26 | 13/24 (54.2%) |
| OPTIMIZED | CNYRUBF | 82 / 1.614 / +23.49 | 106 / 1.434 / +23.87 | 15/24 (62.5%) |

Confirmed 2024 weakness: Si/CNY Gross R falls 94.03→19.76 Baseline and 98.20→35.72 Optimized, before C1. Fewer winning trades / large MFE excursions; all February–May and July FX months are negative already gross. July has 10/15 trades with recorded MFE<0.5R in both controls. C1 aggravates but does not explain the main currency decline; IMOEX C1 is materially large (2024: 12.01R Baseline / 11.64R Optimized). Every individual instrument/version 2024 result is negative without its five best trades. GLD/IMOEX improve over short 2023, so no universal regime claim is made. False-breakout/range explanations remain hypotheses, not findings or tested filters.

All 160 existing historical WF trades exactly match the corresponding continuous Optimized subset: PF 0.926554, -6.770054R. Other 56 closed 2024 trades contribute +34.904685R. No new WF was run and no settings selected from this reference.

All eight full-period closed-trade C1 sums are positive, but durable standalone complete economics is **not demonstrated**. There is one open terminal IMOEXF position per control; no exit/P&L was invented. Close-signal fills, continuous stop prices and conservative MAE/MFE are historical assumptions. Funding, dividends, other fees/spread/slippage, margin/sizing and executable fills remain unproven, not zero-imputed. No period is newly declared TRUE OOS; 2025–2026 OHLC/results were not used for calculation/selection.

GitHub compare confirms one new commit and exactly 29 additions under the allowed new directory, with no outside changes. TradingSystemLab, existing IntradayLab results, LIVE robot/authority/schedules/kill switch and active Optimization Level Rejection branch/PR/results are untouched. title: IntradayLab: T3 M15 holding and entry diagnostics v1
body:
Completed T3/M15 diagnostics reconstruct the original PR #490 execution without changing signals, exits, parameters or existing results. The 2024 positive C1 result depends on positions that actually cross calendar midnight; weak early continuation accounts for most observed negative R, while losses after +2R are rare. Full perpetual economics remains unresolved.

**Draft for external audit. Stop after creation; no merge or auto-merge.**

- Actual discovery/main/base: `d963b783b9de31fc0f2c965f6dfb11ab9cd90f5b` (merged PR #490).
- Mandatory read-only data pin/main: `f8486b446cf3d5f9f3cba6dfec32bdef8fd184c8`.
- Scope: 2023–2024, four instruments, exactly two already fixed versions (trail ATR 3.0 / 3.5). All additions are under `IntradayLab/t3_m15_holding_diagnostics_v1/`.

| 2024 descriptive bookkeeping | BASELINE | OPTIMIZED |
|---|---:|---:|
| Same-entry-date C1 Net R | -119.84 | -130.96 |
| Cross-midnight C1 Net R | +148.97 | +190.84 |
| Share of negative R from recorded MFE<0.5R trades | 67.5% | 65.0% |
| Share of negative R after recorded MFE≥1R | 8.7% | 10.3% |
| Recorded MFE≥2R then net-loss trades | 3 | 2 |

These are normalized trade-risk bookkeeping sums, **not portfolio returns or causal estimates of a new rule**. Actual holding/exit-date partitions are retrospective and never select trades. The 2023 USDRUBF same-date group is positive, so the weakness is not universal across years.

The report separates original recorded MFE, observed lower bounds and possible intrabar upper bounds, including Stop-at-Open and gaps. First 1/2/4 completed candles include explicit exposure censoring and marked post-exit price movement. Preentry EMA/ADX/ATR/H1 and Donchian use only information available at the signal. Stop paths preserve stop-first execution, next-bar trailing activation and original same-bar re-entry. Two open terminal IMOEXF positions are not liquidated or included in closed economics.

Funding, dividend adjustments, other fees/spread/slippage, margin/sizing and executable fills remain **unknown, not zero**. Extra-cost break-even budgets are mathematical sensitivity units, not actual tariffs. In 2024 USDRUBF the additional aggregate round-trip budget is only 0.689 / 1.027 bps of entry price-equivalent notional.

Next experiments proposed, **not executed**: ONE_BAR, then TRAIL1, then SESSION after historical full-cost reconstruction. LOCK1 is below priority given the small observed loss volume after large excursions; profitable-tail damage remains a risk.

Validation:

- Six hand-calculated/causality tests PASS.
- Independent standard-library implementation confirms all 1,442 original closed trades, 2 open positions, 28,541 Stop rows, 23,104 preentry feature values, 4,332 available first-candle records, 324 candle summary rows, 1,697 aggregate rows and 701 fixed-version common-entry pairs.
- Maximum numeric difference 4.73e-11; absolute tolerance 1e-8, exact keys/timestamps/booleans.
- Two fresh process chains reproduce identical SHA-256 for all 25 generated artifacts, their hash manifests and audit results.
- All 29 completed Baseline files match actual-main Git blobs; pinned data worktree is clean. Existing discovery files, TradingSystemLab/LIVE and active Optimization Level Rejection are untouched.
- Implementation independence uses the same author; external reviewer audit remains PENDING.

Entry point: `README.md` and `REPORT.md`; per-trade/Stop/candle diagnostics, instrument/year/month/direction/holding/carry cuts, concentration and economic budgets are included as CSV/JSON. No new Optimization, Robustness, Walk Forward, TRUE OOS or alternate execution was run. No merge/auto-merge requested.

title: research(IntradayLab): T3 M15 gross-only entry/regime v1
body:
## Summary

Seven preregistered standalone entry/regime mechanisms are replayed on both fixed T3/M15 controls (ATR trailing 3.0 / 3.5), using the complete available 2023–2024 prefixes for USDRUBF, CNYRUBF, GLDRUBF and IMOEXF. Every comparison is Gross-only with zero cost calculations or deductions. A2 uses the user's fixed first-four-completed-bar window; no window search, combinations or Optimization.

PR #494 was confirmed merged before research; starting main `758a0ac1deda8bfa7aa1bc99d8a97a33a9357f02`. Data pinned to `f8486b446cf3d5f9f3cba6dfec32bdef8fd184c8`. Specification freeze precedes variant outcomes in commit `64c0a8e4`.

| Mechanism | 2024 Gross PF / BASELINE 3.0 | 2024 Gross PF / OPTIMIZED 3.5 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Fixed control | 1.230 | 1.363 |
| A1 ONE_BAR_EXIT | 1.131 | 1.269 |
| A2 TWO_BAR_EXIT, first 4 bars | 1.172 | 1.284 |
| A3 BREAKOUT_BODY_QUALITY | 1.212 | 1.359 |
| A4 H1_ADX_RISING | 1.204 | 1.389 |
| A5 H1_EMA_SLOPE_STRENGTHENING | 1.209 | 1.365 |
| A6 H1_ATR_EXPANSION | 1.427 | 1.557 |
| A7 M15_ATR_RISING | 1.241 | 1.421 |

A6 supplies the clearest 2024 improvement in PF/R, positive months and closed-trade drawdown, while sacrificing trends, trade frequency and about 23.5% / 20.2% of 2023 R. A7 has a smaller 2024 PF improvement and preserves more original large winners and 2023 R. Both are candidates only for a separately authorized follow-up after external audit. A1/A2 worsen 2024; A3/A4/A5 do not show convincing improvement across both controls. No aggregate 2024 PF reaches 2.0, and top-winner concentration rises for every mechanism. Negative results and all instruments are retained.

## Artifacts and validation

- Full report: `IntradayLab/t3_m15_entry_regime_v1/EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md`; monthly heatmap/PF chart, complete trade journals, entry/exit decisions, annual/monthly/instrument/direction reports, November sensitivity and exact-entry winner/loss lineage.
- Control replay reproduces all **1,442 closed trades and two open positions**, including sequence, timestamps, prices, initial/active Stop and Gross R. Original C1 results are unchanged; Gross controls are separate.
- 16 meaningful causal/execution tests PASS. Separate standard-library implementation verifies **10,553 closed records, 16 terminal positions, 6,693 exit decisions, 32,272 signal/occupancy opportunities and 2,448 report rows**, plus November, lineage, winner/loss attribution and top-winner cohorts.
- Two fresh deterministic repeats match every generated replay file byte-for-byte; presentation repeat, source/generated SHA-256 and scope checks included.

Implementation independence is by the same author; external Independent Audit remains **PENDING**. Historical signal-Close entry is preserved as the control oracle and is **not proof of physically executable Close fills**. Continuous Stop pricing remains unchanged; tick-grid work stays separately owned on H1. Stop gaps at the next Open have priority over queued exits; no future intrabar event overrides an already executed Open fill. R sums are bookkeeping, not portfolio returns.

Only the new directory changes. No TradingSystemLab, baseline/diagnostics, roadmap, raw market data, robot, production or broker endpoint changes. 2023–2024 is development-exposed research, not new independent WF; 2025+ OHLC is not parsed. No Robustness, Walk Forward, TRUE OOS, Optimization or next package is run.

**Draft for external audit and the user's decision. GROSS_ONLY / COSTS_DEFERRED / NOT_LIVE_READY. No merge or auto-merge. STOP after this PR.**

Initial Stop remains 2 ATR; trailing remains 3.0 BASELINE / 3.5 OPTIMIZED. Every comparison is gross-only, on complete available four-instrument 2023–2024 prefixes, including GLD/IMOEX late starts.

| Mechanic | BASELINE full PF / R | OPTIMIZED full PF / R | BASELINE 2024 PF / R | OPTIMIZED 2024 PF / R |

S1 supplies the clearest standalone 2024 R contribution while changing 2023 R by −1.616 / +1.060R. It retains 78/81 and 88/90 original ≥2R winners, loses three/two original winner entries through longer occupancy, lowers frequency and increases full/2024 closed-trade DD to 26.510 / 28.471R. S2 improves matched original losses but cuts more winner R; S3's extra entries offset protected winner gains. Neither consistently improves both controls. All negative findings are retained. Starting GitHub main exactly matched expected `bc4f95f48b332f43d79ed10f26fc03c5ad01cd97`; there were no later commits. Data pin `f8486b446cf3d5f9f3cba6dfec32bdef8fd184c8` remains clean/read-only. Trading engine, causal tests and independent auditor were committed before S outcomes in `4beb8813`.

The replay checks the active Stop before favorable extremes/activation, honors adverse Open gaps and never revises an executed exit using the exit candle's High/Low. All R thresholds use immutable initial risk; new Stops act only next observed candle. Occupancy, original same-Close re-entry, sessions and terminal OPEN are fully replayed. Historical signal-Close entry and continuous Stop pricing remain unverified execution assumptions; closed-trade cumulative R is bookkeeping, not portfolio capital return.

Maximum numeric difference 5.46e-12.

No C1, commission, spread, slippage, funding or any other deductions are calculated/applied. Only the new `IntradayLab/t3_m15_stop_exit_v1/` changes. Previous research, ROADMAP, TradingSystemLab, source data, production robot, broker configurations and real accounts are untouched. No combinations, extra thresholds, numeric search, Optimization, Robustness, Walk Forward, TRUE OOS, LIVE, merge or auto-merge.

title: IntradayLab: T3/M15 Session Entry v1 — fixed T1/T2 gross-only replays
body:
Фиксированные ограничения новых входов T3/M15 проверены отдельными полными replay за весь доступный 2023–2024. T1 разрешает signal Close 10:00–18:00 МСК (18:00 исключено); T2 блокирует только первую завершённую свечу после наблюдаемого gap >15 минут и отдельно отсутствие предшественника. Каждый механизм исполнен самостоятельно на BASELINE trailing 3.0 ATR и OPTIMIZED trailing 3.5 ATR; Initial Stop 2 ATR, исходные сигналы/H1/Stop-first/выходы/переносы не изменены.

**GROSS_ONLY / COSTS_DEFERRED / NOT_LIVE_READY.** 2023–2024 development-exposed; нового независимого Walk Forward/OOS нет. Close-fill остаётся непроверенным историческим предположением.

| Версия | CONTROL PF / R | T1 PF / R | T2 PF / R |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BASELINE | 1.4542 / 144.4112 | 1.5475 / 135.5203 | 1.4480 / 141.1740 |
| OPTIMIZED | 1.5462 / 178.7198 | 1.6784 / 175.7446 | 1.5299 / 172.8698 |

**Полный PF ≥2,0 не достигнут.** T1 улучшает положительные месяцы 15→17 и 17→18 и CLOSED-R DD 23.6765→18.6022R и 26.1261→17.5995R. Цена: входов меньше на 23.3%/21.7%, полный Gross R ниже на 8.8910R/2.9752R, потеряны по 17 исходных победителей ≥2R. Худший месяц и некоторые SHORT/инструментальные разрезы ухудшаются. T2 ухудшает полный PF/R и не увеличивает положительные месяцы. Все отрицательные результаты сохранены. Имеется ограниченное основание продолжать отдельные исследования session-архитектуры по T1 только после внешнего аудита и нового решения пользователя; архитектура не принята.

Все 60 новых файлов находятся исключительно в `IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/`. TradingSystemLab, ROADMAP, замороженные исследования и market-pattern-data не изменены.

- Фактический remote main: `4b415f95576e00480e344a1da498c35660eef931`, совпадает с ожидаемым Merge #498. Данные pinned `f8486b446cf3d5f9f3cba6dfec32bdef8fd184c8`; OHLC 2025+ не парсятся.
- Спецификация и весь исполняемый код зафиксированы **до T1/T2 результатов** в `e8feb7ac351c9548d61abee0e06462485e852fc1`. Отдельный pre-variant gate — `680302bb`.
- 27 причинных тестов PASS: точные часовые границы/UTC, первая свеча после gap, сутки/выходные/год, LONG/SHORT, Stop-first/Open gap, сохранение открытой позиции/Stop при запрете, same-Close re-entry, повторная обработка занятости, prefix invariance и запрет будущего OHLC.
- CONTROL воспроизведён: **1 442 CLOSED +2 terminal OPEN**. Все общие торговые поля #490/#495 и OPEN сверены; численный допуск 1e−8, расхождений 0.
- Независимая stdlib реализация парсера/рекурсивных индикаторов/допуска/replay/отчётов: **2 349 589** полей журналов, **29 406** полей отчётов, **81 098** полей диагностики PASS. Независимость алгоритмическая, автор тот же; внешний аудит PENDING.
- Два свежих полных побайтных повтора: все **34** сгенерированных артефакта совпали в каждом повторе. Общий SHA, неизменность source/reference/frozen code и scope проверены.

Материалы для ревью:

- [Полный отчёт с каждым календарным месяцем и LONG/SHORT](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/results/REPORT.md)
- [Классификация цели, регулярности, цены улучшения и основания для продолжения](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/CONCLUSIONS.md)
- [Причинность](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/CAUSALITY_REPORT.md), [предварительный gate](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/PRE_VARIANT_GATE.json)
- [Вторая вычислительная реализация и аудит](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/AUDIT_RESULTS.json), [повторы](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/REPEATABILITY.json), [SHA](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/ARTIFACT_SHA256.json), [изоляция](IntradayLab/t3_m15_session_entry_v1/SCOPE_CHECK.json)

Полные trade/entry/Stop/gap журналы, периодные OPEN, месяцы/годы/инструменты/направления, крупные победители, новые убытки, изменения последующих входов, длительность/частота/наблюдаемые ночные gaps, T1 часовые запреты и T2 причины сохранены в `results/`.

**STOP для внешнего аудита и решения пользователя.** Один Draft PR, без Merge/Auto-Merge. Numerical Optimization, Robustness, Walk Forward, TRUE OOS, LIVE и новые комбинации не выполнялись.

title: IntradayLab: T3/M15 T1+S1 v1 — audit #499 PASS, full PF goal not reached
body:
После собственного независимого FIRST GATE аудита #499 проверено ровно одно новое сочетание: T1_CORE_HOURS_ENTRY + S1_TRAIL_AFTER_1R, с неизменными BASELINE trailing 3.0 / OPTIMIZED 3.5 ATR и Initial Stop 2 ATR. Каждая траектория CONTROL/T1/S1/T1+S1 исполнена полным самостоятельным causal replay за всю фактически доступную историю четырёх инструментов 2023–2024, с поздним началом GLD/IMOEX, Stop-first, Open gap, занятостью и повторными входами.

**GROSS_ONLY / COSTS_DEFERRED / NOT_LIVE_READY. 2023–2024: DEVELOPMENT_EXPOSED.** Вход по signal Close и Stop fills остаются непроверенными историческими предположениями; net profitability/live readiness не заявлены.

| Версия | Replay | CLOSED / OPEN | Gross PF | Gross R | Expectancy R | CLOSED-R DD | +месяцев/24 | 2024 PF / R |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| BASELINE | CONTROL | 741 / 1 | 1.4542 | 144.4112 | 0.1949 | 23.6765 | 15 | 1.2296 / 50.2063 |
| BASELINE | T1 | 568 / 1 | 1.5475 | 135.5203 | 0.2386 | 18.6022 | 17 | 1.3434 / 57.6028 |
| BASELINE | S1 | 718 / 1 | 1.4854 | 166.7215 | 0.2322 | 26.5098 | 17 | 1.3180 / 74.1322 |
| BASELINE | T1+S1 | 560 / 1 | 1.5864 | 155.7080 | 0.2780 | 20.9216 | 17 | 1.4224 / 75.7769 |
| OPTIMIZED | CONTROL | 701 / 1 | 1.5462 | 178.7198 | 0.2549 | 26.1261 | 17 | 1.3631 / 80.1020 |
| OPTIMIZED | T1 | 549 / 1 | 1.6784 | 175.7446 | 0.3201 | 17.5995 | 18 | 1.4699 / 81.9958 |
| OPTIMIZED | S1 | 689 / 1 | 1.5771 | 196.7080 | 0.2855 | 28.4715 | 17 | 1.4243 / 97.0304 |
| OPTIMIZED | T1+S1 | 545 / 1 | 1.7191 | 192.8192 | 0.3538 | 21.3400 | 17 | 1.5199 / 94.4229 |

**Полная цель PF≥2 не достигнута; архитектура не принята.** Относительно T1 Gross R вырос на 20.1877/17.0745R, но DD выше на 2.3194/3.7405R, серии убыточных месяцев выросли 2→3, OPTIMIZED потерял один положительный месяц. Относительно S1 полный Gross R ниже на 11.0135/3.8889R при улучшении PF/expectancy/DD. PF 2.1373 только в OPTIMIZED 2023 не считается общей целью.

Сохранились неизменными 62/81 и 72/90 исходных CONTROL победителей ≥2R; потеряны 19/18. Относительно T1 дополнительно потеряны 2/1 крупный победитель из-за более долгой занятости; новых CLOSED-входов относительно T1 нет. Относительно CONTROL новые 30/32 CLOSED дали 22/24 новых убытка и −13.5247/−9.7563R. Без ноября 2024 PF 1.2018/1.2958; без top10 за 2024 лишь 1.0705/1.0826. Все отрицательные результаты и детали сохранены.

Проверки:

- Фактический GitHub main `249a9f58a726416bee9d3efd259a9824d348e292` совпал с ожидаемым Merge #499; исходные M15 pinned `f8486b446cf3d5f9f3cba6dfec32bdef8fd184c8`. SHA всех источников/префиксов/ссылок проверены; OHLC 2025+ не читается для расчётов или выбора.
- Собственный внешний по отношению к #499 stdlib replay не импортирует его engine, metrics или internal audit: **2,580,630 полей, 0 расхождений**, CONTROL 1442 CLOSED +2 OPEN, T1/T2, все Stop/entry/gap/OPEN и отчёты. Pre-result freeze #499 и GitHub scope подтверждены. Audit commit `623797c90c8300e6b917ecd1edbb07f52628db04`.
- Отдельный code/spec/test/source freeze **`4012bc519bce58ca08314663a149204a0ad383a5`**, отправлен до первого исторического COMBINED результата. Все 11 Python файлов, спецификация, параметры, SHA и условия оценки неизменны. Post-freeze pre-combination gate commit `f7821fb0f8c93300f35af002499bf0ca95a387f4`.
- CONTROL `741+701`, S1 `718+689`, T1 `568+549 CLOSED` и по два OPEN воспроизведены до комбинации по всем общим gross торговым полям, допуск 1e-8. Primary reference gate **1,119,943** полей; отдельный benchmark replay **3,747,448**, расхождений 0. Исторические C1/net/tick экономические поля исключены, издержки не рассчитываются.
- **40 causal fixtures PASS**: LONG/SHORT, exact T1/T2, H1/Donchian/prefix causality, Stop-first/Open gaps, surviving post-entry 1R activation, next observed bar Stop, ratchet/holding/occupancy/re-entry, poison future OHLC guard.
- Полная отдельная scalar реализация проверила **5071 CLOSED, 8 terminal OPEN, 103150 Stop, 16136 entry, 18960 gap, 92 period OPEN**, все отчёты и lineage: **4,927,208 полей, 0 расхождений**, max delta `5.4569682106375694e-12`. Вычислительная независимость; оба новых исполнения написаны в этой исследовательской сессии, независимое человеческое ревью не заявлено.
- Два свежих побайтных повтора **31 primary +9 independent +8 FIRST GATE артефактов** в каждом: direct byte equality и SHA256 PASS, включая читаемый отчёт.
- **95 добавленных файлов исключительно `IntradayLab/t3_m15_t1_s1_v1/`**; все байты в Git-tree совпадают с SHA-манифестом. TradingSystemLab, робот, прежние исследования, ROADMAP, market-pattern-data и старый локальный checkout не изменены. Исследовательские CSV/results добавлены явным списком, несмотря на общий .gitignore.
